newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia minister denies report on prostitute.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia minister denies report on prostitute.

text.p: Indonesian Manpower Minister Abdul Latief has said there are no Indonesian prostitutes in Saudi Arabia, the Kompas newspaper reported on Saturday.

Latief's comments contradicted those of Minister for Women's Affairs Mien Sugandhi, who last week said she would go to Saudi Arabia soon to look into the plight of "hundreds" of Indonesian women working there as prostitutes.
"It is not true," Latief said on Friday. "I will not lie about it."
The newspaper gave no further details.
On Monday, the Republika newspaper quoted the Saudi ambassador to Indonesia, Abdullah Abdulrahman Alim, as also saying that no Indonesian women were working as prostitutes in his country.
